mathematics.assertion_tested: On the saved 29-dwarf CFG828 sample, decompose selected-host log Vx coefficient into law velocity and normalized excess using identical size+host design; compare one-parameter nonnegative additive variance and multiplicative law models by cross-host and leave-one-object-out equal-object log-sigma RMSE without excess selection.
mathematics.conventions: canonical and alt a0, nu_e; gobs=3sigma_los^2/rhalf; existing CFG828 and SFH M/L; fitting minimizes equal-object squared log10 sigma error
inputs: 29 CFG828 dwarfs, 24 MW/M31 satellites; all and log gbar < -11.9; selected Delta > 0.05 only for exact CFG856/857 decomposition
non_claims: No independent new observations, global theory proof, or calibrated likelihood ratio.
No assessment of projected-virial validity, anisotropy, binaries, or uncertainty in input law velocities.
Exploratory model comparison on existing post-hoc sample; does not establish physical extra component.
